condition: MultiIndex set operations and get_indexer treat NaN levels as different when one index stores NaN with code -1 and the other uses a nonnegative code (e.g. an index from groupby(dropna=False)). This yields duplicate rows, a non-empty difference, and misaligned arithmetic.
workaround: Rebuild the index so its NaN codes are consistent, e.g. pd.MultiIndex(ix.levels, ix.codes, names=ix.names) with integrity verification turned on, before calling union, difference or arithmetic. Better still, keep NaN out of index keys.
